rules.pass: The host has the CPUs and 90% of the memory of the planning estimate for the roles it runs.
rules.warn: The host has fewer CPUs, or less memory, than the planning estimate. The estimates are for planning, not requirements, so this never fails.
rules.unknown: The CPUs, the memory or the roles could not be read.

advice.enough: The host has {cpus} CPUs and {memory_bytes} of memory, enough for {roles}.
advice.below-estimate: This host has {cpus} CPUs and {memory_bytes} of memory. The planning estimates for {roles} are {need_cpus} CPUs and {need_memory_bytes} of memory. These are planning estimates, not requirements. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#host-resources.

words.relay-and-forger: a relay and a forger together

rules.pass: More than 10% of the memory is available, and no role uses swap.
rules.warn: 10% or less of the memory is available, or a role has memory in swap.
rules.fail: Less than 2% of the memory is available.
rules.unknown: The memory or a role's status could not be read.

advice.low: Only {percent}% of the memory is available. Add memory or stop other services. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#host-memory.
advice.exhausted: Only {percent}% of the memory is available, and the system may stop the node. Add memory or stop other services now. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#host-memory.
advice.swap: The {role} has memory in swap, which slows block processing. Add memory or stop other services. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#host-memory.

rules.pass: The doctor runs as the user who holds the data directory, and not as root.
rules.warn: The doctor runs as root, or as a user other than the one the data directory belongs to.
rules.unknown: The user or the data directory could not be read.

advice.node-user: The doctor runs as user {uid}, who holds the data directory.
advice.root: The doctor runs as root. Run the doctor as the node's user. It needs no privilege. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#host-user.
advice.other-user: The doctor runs as user {uid}, and the data directory belongs to user {holder}, so some checks may not read what they need. Run the doctor as the node's user. It needs no privilege. See https://docs.iceroot.com/validators/doctor/#host-user.
